integrity: The counterexample is symbolic and scale-invariant. Exact rational replay checks every displayed constant and the first inner/outer update; no finite experiment is used to infer the universal claim.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the literal stopping/output rules in arXiv:2605.06016v1 with the same tolerance used as the stationarity target. It does not assert failure when the raw stopping test is disabled or tightened, and it does not concern the paper's numerical experiments that initialize BFGS with the identity.
title: A raw-step stopping mismatch in zeroth-order proximal Newton
